scope.summary: Implement fail-closed demo data onboarding and an owner-only existing-venue loader; record known CI and hosted-isolation blockers without claiming feature acceptance.
implemented: Added setup sample-team and post-onboarding owner loader gated by explicit deployment configuration, matching Supabase project identification and database-side approval.
Added tagged fictional FOH/BOH employees, availability, published rosters, attendance/correction and illustrative payroll-preparation examples with idempotent and existing-record protections.
Added database authorization, provenance, audit and safeguards against demo account links, invitations and payroll mapping; documented activation prerequisites and limitations.

Added the owner-provided fixes in commits 6177831 and 1801a94 for restricted provenance reads and service-role employee-update regression coverage; corrected malformed pgTAP dollar quoting and added the missing audit-source label found by CI.

criteria.description: Authorized development owner can choose sample team during new onboarding and can later load fictional demo data into an existing development workspace.

evidence.outcome: Both user-facing paths are implemented. Fast candidate database/pgTAP and critical browser smoke tests passed, but the demo flow has not been visibly accepted on the hosted development app.
Passed 7/7 environment-policy and navigation tests; these do not verify live deployment acceptance.

criteria.description: Same controls remain inoperative for production, unidentified or shared customer databases, including via direct API invocation.

evidence.outcome: Application requires explicit environment/project settings; database RPC requires matching administrator approval and owner authorization. The hosted project's isolation is unverified.

Verify validated the evidence pair, then npm test failed because the new audited source workspace_demo_data_loads lacked a UI label. The label is added and the focused test passes; lint/build were skipped.

criteria.description: Seed/reseed preserves real data and tenant boundaries; fictional provenance and counts are visible; repeats produce no duplicates.

evidence.outcome: Migration and regression coverage implement clean-venue refusal, tenant-scoped provenance, idempotent fixture loading and counts. Fast database candidate run 43962627856 passed migration/pgTAP and authenticated cross-tenant isolation; the full Verify database/browser job remains in progress.
The most recent local attempt exited before database setup because Supabase CLI 2.122.0 was unavailable; local database verification is not claimed.

criteria.description: No outbound invitations, messages or payroll execution, including Xero, are triggered by demo records.

evidence.outcome: Synthetic account-link, invitation and payroll-mapping protections and payroll-input exclusions are implemented. Fast candidate pgTAP passed, including service-role update and synthetic-account-link regression coverage. No external provider was used.
Owner-added pgTAP coverage includes the blocked demo employee account-link case; no external provider was used. The CI test process failed on malformed quoting in the final regression query.

criteria.description: Targeted and required CI pass; the completed PR documents deployment verification and operator activation steps.

evidence.outcome: Evidence validation passed; npm test failed on a missing audit-source label, now added. The full Verify database/tenant-isolation steps passed and its browser step is still running; required Verify is not green.
Operator activation prerequisites and user-facing behavior/limitations are documented, but hosted project verification and required green checks are outstanding.
